title: MeasurementPlan
description: The architect artifact: tooling prescriptions + metric definitions for one target. Drafts must be confirmed by the user before records are judged against them.

status.description: draft = machine-generated proposal; confirmed = user signed off (npm run plan -- --confirm).

phase.description: Plan-level judgment proposed by the agent from matrix signals and signed by the user (--phase). Re-weights priorities; never stored in records.

basedOnProfile.description: Path or id of the RepoProfile this plan was drafted from.

concern.description: external-monitoring = world-facing numbers (external.*/perception.*) collected via existing generic tools (gh api, registries, target monitors) — never new target-specific code.

present.description: true = already installed/used in the target; false = prescription (the target must adopt it — adopting is the target's own work, never this toolkit's).

id.description: Dot notation with camelCase segments; must exist in METRICS.md (canonical vocabulary).

layer.description: B=workflow, C=runtime/site, E=outward (external.*/perception.*), S=scale (business.*/philosophy.*) per METRICS.md.

source.description: How the number is collected — an existing tool/output, never new target-specific code written by this toolkit.

instrumentMissing.description: true = no source tool exists in the target yet; numbers cannot be collected until the prescription is adopted.
